$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}0 & 2 & 5 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & -3 & 7 \\ 4 & 0 & 6 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 6\end{bmatrix}
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
The first non-zero entry of each row (from left to right) is the leading entry.

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}0 & 2 & 5 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & -3 & 7 \\ 4 & 0 & 6 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 6\end{bmatrix}

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}0 & 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -4\end{bmatrix}
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:

Therefore, the leading entries of the $2\text{nd}$ and $4\text{th}$ rows of $A$ are $-2$ and $-4$, respectively.

$$
A=\begin{bmatrix}0 & 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -4\end{bmatrix}
$$

So, the answer is $-2+(-4)=-6.$
